policy.title: Cookie policy
policy.intro: This policy explains which cookies Colabora MLS uses and why. A cookie is a small text file that a website stores in your browser.
policy.usedBody: We only use cookies that the site needs to work. We don't use advertising or analytics cookies, and we don't share cookie data with anyone.

purpose.session: Keeps you logged in to the agency panel.
purpose.csrf: Protects the login form against forged requests.
purpose.callback: Remembers which page to open after you log in.
purpose.consent: Remembers your cookie choice (the accepted categories, the policy version and a random consent ID), so we don't ask again. We also keep a record of each choice with that ID, the date and the policy version, without your IP address, for 3 years.

policy.prefixNote: On the live site, the login cookie names start with __Secure- or __Host-.
policy.legalBody: Cookies that are strictly necessary for a service you ask for don't need consent under article 22.2 of the Spanish Information Society Services Law (LSSI, Law 34/2002). If we ever add optional cookies, such as analytics, we will only set them after you accept them, and we will update this policy first.
policy.manageBody: You can change or withdraw your choice at any time with the button below or the "Cookie settings" link at the bottom of every page. Withdrawing is as easy as giving consent. You can also delete or block cookies in your browser settings; if you block the necessary ones, you won't be able to log in.
policy.categoriesBody: Cookies are grouped in three categories: necessary, analytics and marketing. Only necessary cookies are set without your consent. Analytics and marketing cookies are only set after you accept them, and we don't use any at the moment.

meta.title: Colabora MLS – Collaboration network for estate agencies on the Spanish coast
meta.description: More buyers for your listings and more listings for your buyers: the network of verified agencies on the Spanish coast. 6 months free.

hero.title: Where estate agencies and developers work together

hero.trust: Verified agencies only · Kyero import · No commitment

notice.title: Legal notice
notice.description: Who runs Colabora MLS and the terms of use of this website.
notice.intro: In accordance with article 10 of Spanish Law 34/2002 on Information Society Services (LSSI), these are the details of the owner of this website.

owner.title: Owner

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.body: This website presents Colabora MLS, a private collaboration network for estate agencies and property developers, and gives its members access to their panel. Use of the panel is also governed by the Terms of use.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body:
The texts, design, code and brand of this website belong to {company} or its licensors and may not be copied or reused without permission.

The properties, developments, photos and documents published by members belong to whoever publishes them.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body:
{company} is not responsible for the information published by network members or for the agreements between them, nor for external websites linked from here.

We try to keep the website running without interruptions, but cannot guarantee it at all times.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: This notice is governed by Spanish law. Any dispute is submitted to the courts of {courts}, unless the law provides otherwise.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What personal data Colabora MLS processes, why, for how long, and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.intro: This policy explains how {company} processes personal data in Colabora MLS, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD).

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body:
{company}, tax ID {cif}, registered office at {address}.

For any question about your data: {email}.

data.title: What data we process
data.body:
- Agencies and developers applying to join: company details (legal name, tax ID, agents' registry number, address, website), the contact person's and the owner's details (name and ID number), phone numbers, email addresses and, if provided, the IBAN.
- Login accounts: email, encrypted password, language and login dates.
- Properties and developments published by members, with their photos and documents.
- Buyers an agency adds to its CRM or to a client page, or registers in a development: name, phone, email, notes and what the buyer indicates on their page (likes, comments, viewing requests).
- Contact form: name, email, phone if given, and your message.
- Statistics on each property's views and WhatsApp clicks: we don't store IP addresses; we use an anonymous key that changes every day.
- Cookies: see the Cookie policy.

purposes.title: Purposes and legal basis
purposes.body:
- Reviewing your application, managing your account and providing the service: performance of a contract (art. 6.1.b GDPR).
- Answering contact form messages: your consent (art. 6.1.a GDPR).
- Security, abuse prevention and statistics: legitimate interest (art. 6.1.f GDPR).
- Invoicing and tax and accounting obligations: legal obligation (art. 6.1.c GDPR).

We don't make automated decisions with legal effects on you or build marketing profiles.

buyers.title: Buyers' data
buyers.body:
When an agency enters its buyers' details, the agency is the controller of that data and {company} acts as processor on the agency's behalf (art. 28 GDPR). The agency must inform its buyers and have a legal basis to process their data and to share it with a developer when registering them in a development.

Developers only see the names of registered buyers, not their phone or email.

recipients.title: Who receives the data
recipients.body:
- Other network members: they see your agency's or company's business contact details and the properties and developments you share.
- Service providers, under a data processing agreement: web hosting ({hosting}), database (MongoDB Atlas), photo and document storage (Cloudflare R2) and email delivery ({emailProvider}).
- Public authorities and courts, when required by law.

Some providers may process data outside the European Economic Area; when they do, it is with GDPR safeguards (the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or the EU-US Data Privacy Framework). We don't sell personal data.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body:
- Account and service data: while the account is active. After closing it, we delete it within 30 days.
- Rejected applications: 12 months.
- Contact form messages: as long as needed to answer them, and at most 12 months.
- Invoices and accounting data: for the period required by law (generally 6 years).

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body:
You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, object to its processing, ask for it to be restricted or ported, and withdraw your consent at any time. Write to {email} saying which right you want to exercise.

If you think we haven't handled your data properly, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

security.title: Security
security.body: Passwords are stored encrypted, the website only works over a secure connection (HTTPS), and each member can only see and change the data of their own account.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If we change this policy significantly, we'll email members before the change takes effect.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: Terms of use of the Colabora MLS collaboration network for estate agencies and property developers.
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of Colabora MLS, a service of {company} (tax ID {cif}). By creating an account, the agency or developer accepts these terms.

service.title: The service
service.body:
Colabora MLS is a private collaboration network for estate agencies and property developers. It lets members share properties and developments, find other members' listings and contact them.

Colabora MLS is not a portal for buyers and takes no part in transactions: it does not act as an agent, takes no commission on sales and is not a party to agreements between members.

access.title: Who can use it
access.body:
- Verified estate agencies and property developers only. We review every application and may refuse it.
- Each member is responsible for the accuracy of its registration details and for keeping them up to date.
- Login details are personal: don't share them. Tell us straight away if you think someone else has used them.

rules.title: Network rules
rules.body:
- Only publish properties you are authorised by the owner to market.
- The information you publish must be accurate and up to date (price, availability, features).
- Each member freely sets its collaboration terms on each property; Colabora MLS does not impose commissions or splits.
- Buyer registrations in a development follow the conditions set by each developer.
- Other members' contact details may only be used to collaborate within the network.

content.title: Content you publish
content.body:
You are responsible for the properties, developments, photos, documents and texts you publish, and for holding the rights to them. You authorise us to show them to network members and on the client pages and XML exports you set up.

We may hide content that breaks these terms or the law, telling you why.

price.title: Price
price.body:
The price and payment terms of each type of account are those shown on the website when you join. Developer accounts are free during the launch phase.

If we change the price, we'll email you at least 30 days in advance and you can leave at no cost before it applies.

leaving.title: Leaving and suspension
leaving.body:
You can leave whenever you like by writing to {email}; there is no minimum term.

We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms, normally after a warning; in serious cases, immediately.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body:
Colabora MLS makes it easier for professionals to work together but does not guarantee sales or results. We are not responsible for the information published by members or for the agreements between them.

We try to keep the service available at all times, but there may be interruptions for maintenance or reasons beyond our control. Except where the law does not allow it, our liability is limited to the amounts paid by the member in the previous 12 months.

data.title: Data protection
data.body: How personal data is processed is explained in the Privacy policy. For buyers' data entered by members, {company} acts as processor on each member's behalf, in accordance with article 28 GDPR.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: If we change these terms significantly, we'll email members at least 30 days in advance. If you don't agree, you can leave at no cost before they apply.

law.title: Governing law and courts
law.body: These terms are governed by Spanish law. Any dispute is submitted to the courts of {courts}.
